overview.description: Colonies don't equal success - undigested plasmid and contamination produce false positives that look identical to real clones. First check your control plates, then patch-plate and colony-PCR your candidates, and confirm the best ones with a diagnostic digest (or sequencing).
objectives: run a patch plate + colony PCR to screen candidates
confirm identity by diagnostic restriction digest

steps.description: Colonies don't equal success - undigested plasmid and contamination produce false positives that look identical to real clones. First check your control plates, then patch-plate and colony-PCR your candidates, and confirm the best ones with a diagnostic digest (or sequencing).
steps.intro: Colonies don't equal success - undigested plasmid and contamination produce false positives that look identical to real clones. First check your control plates, then patch-plate and colony-PCR your candidates, and confirm the best ones with a diagnostic digest (or sequencing).

instructions.title: Check controls first
instructions.description: Confirm each control plate matches expectations before screening anything.

instructions.title: Patch + colony PCR
instructions.description: Number colonies, patch them onto a gridded plate, and colony-PCR each with junction/spanning primers.

instructions.title: Gel the screen
instructions.description: Run the colony PCR on a gel; candidates with the expected band advance.

instructions.title: Diagnostic digest
instructions.description: Miniprep the best candidates and digest to confirm band sizes match the in-silico map.

submission.description: Submit a colony-PCR gel and a diagnostic-digest gel identifying at least one confirmed correct clone.
